verifier_note: Every url was re-opened on 2026-10-02 (the official results workbooks were downloaded and the Statewide House sheets read). Corrected: Conrad and Niemiec office sources (write-in counts and a Wikipedia mention not re-checked, so taken out; Conrad's District 19 votes confirmed all cast in Uinta County), Posey's website note (the Legislature roster claim was not re-checked), and Bratten's website address (the old one forwards to the new).
note: Past runs were read from the Wyoming Secretary of State's official results workbooks (general and primary, 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024); they carry state and federal offices only, not county offices. R. Mark Armstrong (Albany County Clerk) shares his name with a 2020 Republican primary candidate for U.S. Senate (and a Mark Armstrong ran in the 2022 Republican primary for Secretary of State), but no source read ties that person to the Albany County race, so nothing is recorded. Hans Odde is listed as Park County's 1st Deputy Clerk on the county's page; that is a staff post, not an office, so it is not recorded. Campaign websites were found through BallotReady's candidate pages (only the link was taken) or by trying the plain domain; each site was opened and names the candidate and the office. The session's web search allowance ran out early in this part, so Mary Greene, Travis Grosz, Beau Fulton, Bernie E. Jensen, Gabriel Koerber, Matt Windley, Ali Dunford, Mike Laird, Adrian Keeler, Dale Davis, Shannon A. Brennan and Bob Davis were looked for only on their county, city or school district's own site and at plain domains; Goshen #1's and Park #1's sites did not answer, and Sweetwater #1's and Fremont #1's board lists are drawn by script. The Wyoming Legislature's site draws its member pages by script, so sitting members' official pages were not read (they have record pages already). The Wyoming party pages read for ballot/lean/wy_endorsements.json carry no endorsement for these races.
